display_name: Car Parking VR - Learn To Park
display_long_description:
Car parking enter the world of precision driving in Car Parking VR – Learn to Park game, the ultimate car parking simulator VR game built for Meta Quest 2 & 3. Master every turn, reverse, and tight spot with realistic driving physics and smooth VR controls designed for parking perfection.

Challenge yourself through realistic parking levels — from easy street parking to extreme multi-level garages. Practice parallel parking, reverse parking, and diagonal spots with accurate collision detection and lifelike steering feedback. Every mission helps you sharpen your skills and feel like a real driver.

With detailed cars, responsive handling, and adjustable sensitivity, Car Parking VR – Learn to Park delivers the most immersive VR parking experience ever created. Unlock new cars, upgrade performance, and complete time trials to earn the title of Parking Master.

 Features:
• True-to-life car parking VR simulator with realistic controls
• Multiple parking challenges: reverse, parallel, and multi-story garage levels
• Improve car handling and precision
• Smooth driving physics with adjustable steering & brake response
• Time trial mode for competitive parking
• Future update: multiplayer parking challenge mode to compete with friends
Whether you’re practicing real driving skills or love a good parking challenge, this game delivers the perfect mix of realism and fun. Become the ultimate VR Parking Pro, park smart, drive clean, and prove your skill in Car Parking VR – Learn to Park.
